log.what: same-day cut of the Friday open (12:43; 106 cues). Eight lines on H6, all LP; the slate lines sorted, not scored. Reductions filed; one quotation under fifteen words

split.note: one station, two voices, one sign (−0.3 → −0.8). Grim carries the record (10–22), Krystal the frames (16–24); RP is in the room and silent on the object

scoreboard.zRule: every line carries a z, inferred where implied (Sailor 2026-10-13); inferred lines are marked zInferred with a zWhy

lines.quote: Rory Johnston, yesterday: about 950 VLCC tankers in the world — just under a thousand — and a couple are getting hit every day, or several a week, depending on the volume of Iran's attacks
lines.note: THE FLEET COUNT: a new denominator for H6 — not barrels through, but hulls left
lines.zWhy: a fleet losing hulls daily is not a controlled strait

lines.quote: what we've learned through this conflict is that the physical reality matters — the number of refineries, the pipelines, the straits we move refined products through
lines.note: the mechanism stated as a lesson: the object is physical — Prism's own grammar in LP register
lines.zWhy: physical constraint reads against a count-based 'open'

lines.quote: when Trump says the strait is open — if he means two out of every ten ships going through are getting hit, then at some point they're going to run out of ships
lines.note: THE CHALLENGE: H6's Z-assertion ('open', 19M barrels) read against its own loss rate — the line the cut exists for

lines.quote: they're running out of capacity to repair them — a blown engine room is normally a several-month process, and now you're in line behind all the other tankers with holes
lines.note: THE SECOND CONSTRAINT: yard capacity — a layer no reader had named
lines.zWhy: repair queues mean each hit removes a hull for months

lines.quote: this isn't something where you can just keep having the Coast Guard or the US Navy send ships through and lose a couple a day
lines.note: escort as an attrition problem, not a control problem
lines.zWhy: the convoy loses what it escorts

lines.quote: China basically saved us over the past several months by surprisingly and dramatically reducing its imports — and that is changing; the strategic reserves are all but drained; a hot PPI — wholesale prices to be passed to consumers
lines.note: three records in one breath: China's import drop (the flow layer), the SPR, the PPI
lines.zWhy: the buffers that masked the shortfall are spent

lines.quote: you'd be hard-pressed to find a better predictor of Trump's political fortunes than the gas prices
lines.note: THE CROSS-ARC PREDICATE, third sighting (Krystal 10-15 '1:1'; Kitroeff 10-14 'could'): now 'the best predictor'
lines.zWhy: the pump as the slate's instrument — not on H6's axis, scored lightly

lines.quote: between the Houthi escalation and Iran clamping down on the Strait of Hormuz after the UN General Assembly, it is not a pretty picture
lines.note: the two chokepoints named and dated (post-UNGA)
lines.zWhy: two chokepoints under pressure is the opposite of control
